infoCards.title: Production Management

infoCards.title: Quality & Safety
infoCards.description: Integrated quality control and food safety management system.

faqData.question: How does the system ensure food safety compliance?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive food safety management including HACCP compliance, allergen control, quality testing workflows and complete traceability from raw materials to finished products.

faqData.question: What traceability features are included?
faqData.answer: The system offers end-to-end traceability with lot tracking, supplier management and recall capabilities, ensuring compliance with food safety regulations and quick response to quality issues.

faqData.question: Can it handle recipe and nutritional management?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution includes detailed recipe management with version control, nutritional analysis, allergen tracking and scaling capabilities while protecting proprietary formulations.
